title: The solar system
examples: What is the biggest thing in our solar system?
Can you tell me the order of the planets?
Are all the planets made of rock?

explain.say: Our solar system has one big star at its center.
Now let me show you the real thing in 3D: the solar system. Look at the sun, the mercury and the venus. Tap any part, and I will tell you what it does.
The Sun is a giant ball of hot gas that gives us light.
The eight planets orbit the Sun in a specific order.
The first four planets are small and rocky in nature.
The outer planets are much larger and are mostly made of gas.
In real life, the planets follow paths around the Sun.

faq.q: Which planet is the biggest one in the solar system?
faq.a: Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system. It is much bigger than all the other planets combined.

faq.q: Do all planets have rings like Saturn?
faq.a: No, only some planets have visible rings. Saturn is famous for its beautiful ring system.

faq.q: What keeps the planets going around the Sun?
faq.a: The Sun's gravity keeps the planets in their paths. Gravity is a pulling force between objects.
asks: What pulls planets to the Sun?

faq.q: Are the inner planets all rocky?
faq.a: Yes, Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars are all considered rocky planets. They have solid surfaces.
asks: Are the first four planets rock?
What is the composition of inner planets?

faq.q: What is the difference between gas giants and rocky planets?
faq.a: Rocky planets are smaller and made of rock and metal. Gas giants are much bigger and are mostly made of gas.
asks: Can you compare rock vs gas planets?

facts: The Sun is a star, not a planet.
Mercury is the planet closest to the Sun.
The order is Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune.
The inner planets are smaller and rocky.

quiz.say: Which planet comes right after Mars?
quiz.why: Jupiter is the next planet in the sequence after Mars.

wrong.0: Venus is the second planet, not the fifth.
wrong.2: Saturn is much further away from the Sun.
wrong.3: Earth comes before Mars in the order.

quiz.say: Which group of planets are made mostly of gas?
quiz.why: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune are the gas giants.

wrong.0: Rocky planets are made of solid rock and metal.
wrong.1: The Sun is a star, not a planet group.
wrong.2: Inner planets are the rocky ones.

quiz.say: If you list the planets from the Sun outwards, which planet is the third one?
quiz.why: The order is Mercury, Venus, then Earth.

wrong.0: Mars is the fourth planet in line.
wrong.2: Mercury is the very first planet.
